Name: Hophni
Summary: Hophni, son of Eli, served as a priest at Shiloh with his brother Phinehas. The two treated the Lord's offerings with contempt, and both died on the day the ark was captured.
KeyStory: Hophni's corrupt priesthood ended in a single day of judgment at Aphek.
LifeLesson: A sacred office does not protect a corrupt heart; God judges his own house first.
